q: Can a project that started before 2025 earn credits under India's CCTS offset mechanism?
title: CCTS offset project start date rule
short: No. BEE set 1 January 2025 as the start date for registering CCTS offset projects and says no retrospective projects will be considered. The start date is when the project began reducing emissions, and validation must be finished within two years of that date.
audience: Factories and developers with projects commissioned before or after January 2025

ul: Project start date: the date the project began generating emission reductions, avoidance or removals.
January 1, 2025 is the start date for ICM project registrations. No retrospective projects.
Validation must be completed within two years of the project start date.
A boiler, solar plant or biogas unit commissioned in 2024 cannot enter the offset mechanism.
For a project commissioned now, the two-year validation clock is already running, so start the PDD and choose an agency early.
Keep dated proof of commissioning: the purchase order, installation report and first meter readings.
